Ava (PM): Quick kickoff — need to recalibrate Q3 prioritization. I think we should reweight for reliability after the incident; propose envelope shift: 2 big bets, 2 quick wins, 2 polish. Opinions?
Diego (Eng): +1 on reliability focus. Curious what that does to RICE ordering though — some high-impact features drop because effort spikes.
Riley (EM): We ran the RICE pass last week. Raw scores changed after we bumped effort estimates for infra work. Sharing a snippet:```
Feature A (adaptive routing): R7 I8 C0.7 E8 => RICE=(7*8*0.7)/8=4.9
Feature B (latency-4xx mitigation): R6 I9 C0.8 E5 => RICE=(6*9*0.8)/5=8.64
```
Harper (Product Ops): FYI — Sales pulled two customers asking for deterministic tail latency SLA; that's a strong signal for impact.
Kai (Design): If we reprioritize for latency, we should reserve scope for UX fallbacks — e.g., progressive responses. That reduces effort on some experiments.
Ava (PM): Good point, Kai. Tradeoff: ship narrower latency feature with UX fallback vs. full adaptive routing. Both help SLA but different risk/cost profiles.
Diego (Eng): From infra POV, smaller scoped latency work (engine tuning + cache) is 2-3 sprints. Adaptive routing is a 3–4 sprint cross-team project.
Riley (EM): Proposed reweight: boost Confidence weight for customer-validated asks. Currently R,I,C,E are uniform. If we treat Confidence as a tiebreaker, customer asks move up.
Ava (PM): Can we try quick experiment: keep scores but apply a +20% multiplier to features with paying-customer ask? Then rescore top 6 and see ordering.
prio-bot: RICE sheet updated by Riley — https://redwood.internal/sheets/rice-q3 (view only).
Harper (Product Ops): Quick poll: do we accept the +20% customer multiplier? React with :thumbsup: or :thinking:.
Kai (Design): :thumbsup: — leans toward small-scope latency + UX fallback.
Diego (Eng): :thinking: — I want the routing plan but only if we can phase it.
Riley (EM): I'll run the adjusted scores and post the new ordering in 30m. If the multiplier flips ordering substantially, we'll propose a sequencing plan: 1) latency quickwin, 2) adaptive routing canary, 3) GA polish.
Ava (PM): Sounds good. Acceptance criteria for the latency quickwin: 95th p90 improved by 20%, rollout to 10% of traffic with automatic rollback. Add to spec template.
Harper (Product Ops): I'll update the roadmap swimlanes and customer comms draft once Riley posts the new ranks.
Diego (Eng): Also: note dependency on infra capacity tickets (#INF-324, #INF-327). If those slip, effort estimates change.
Ava (PM): Action items: Riley rescore + post, Harper update roadmap, Diego validate infra tickets and ETA, Kai draft fallback UX. We'll reconvene after the new ordering.
Riley (EM): On it — posting results at 1968001350.
prio-bot: Reminder: Quarterly prioritization review meeting scheduled Thu 10:00am.```
